description: Capability for the opening screen (label `splash`), the bundled local page that plays the logo reveal while the dashboard server boots. It needs exactly two things: to ask the shell to start its clip (`splash_play`: played from the shell's eval it counts as a user gesture, which Low Power Mode requires) and to say its clip is done (`splash_done`). No core window controls (the shell shows, fades and closes it from Rust), no events, no shell:*, and no remote URL — it is a local page only.
